trial_court: Family Court, Shimla, Cr. Revision No.266 of 2023 & Cr. Revision No. 562 of 2023
case_name: Sarita Shah And Ors vs Rajesh Chauhan

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sarita Shah and Ors (husband, wife, petitioners)

facts_of_case: Petitioners filed a petition under Section 125 of Cr.P.C. seeking maintenance @ ₹50,000/- per month. Petitioner No.1 was married to the respondent on 18.11.1996 and they resided together as husband and wife. The respondent used to abuse the petitioners after getting intoxicated.

legal_principles.principle: The mere fact that the wife is earning will not disentitle her from claiming maintenance.
legal_principles.held: The mere fact that the wife is earning will not disentitle her from claiming the maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: A father is bound to maintain his major children only if they are unable to maintain themselves due to some disability.
legal_principles.held: It is undisputed that they have become major and a father is bound to maintain his major children only if they are unable to maintain themselves due to some disability.
cited_cases: Abhilasha v. Parkash (2021) 13 SCC 99: 2020 SCC OnLine SC 736

outcome.final_order: Maintenance @ ₹7,000/- was awarded to Devanshi Chauhan and Himanshu Chauhan

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for maintenance under Section 125 CrPC
appealing an order of the Family Court
seeking revision of a maintenance award
